General Data about College of Engineerin: College of Engineering Kottarakkara has been the leading technical institution in Kerala since its venture in 2004. The college is commonly known as CEK located near Navodaya school and ETC at Thrikkannamangal, Kottarakkara. The institution is approved by All India Council for Technical Education(AICTE) , New Delhi and affiliated to APJ Abdul Kalam Technological University (KTU) . It is under the management of IHRD(Institute of Human Resources Development)  Established by Govt. of Kerala. offers B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering (Artificial Intelligence & Machine learning), B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, reflecting the modern technological advancements through its updated syllabi.
